title: Let Me Be Thine Forever
description: Let Me Be Thine Forever in Tonic Solfa to EWING, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Nikolaus Selnecker wrote these words in German. Matthias Loy's translation was printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 408.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens and Sixes Double (7.6.7.6.7.6.7.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to EWING; any other Sevens and Sixes Double tune fits them as well.
underlay: Let me be Thine for-ev-er, Thou faith-ful God and Lord; Let me for-sake Thee nev-er Nor wan-der from Thy Word; Lord, do not let me wa-ver, But give me stead-fast-ness, And for such grace for-ev-er Thy ho-ly name I’ll bless.

lines: Lord, do not let me waver,
For Thou hast dearly bought me
Let me, since Thou hast sought me,
Whom I have known by faith.

licence: Public domain: Nikolaus Selnecker died in 1592; Matthias Loy died in 1915.
credits: Words by Nikolaus Selnecker (1530–1592), translated by Matthias Loy (1828–1915), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to EWING by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
